tr: Do you have the key? / Yes, it's in my bag.
What's the cat's name? / His name is Minou.
Who are you having dinner with tonight? / With Léa's friends.
What street is the café on? / On the rue de la Paix, next to the train station.
Hello, ma'am. / Hello, sir. What would you like?
Hi, how's it going? / I'm fine, thanks. And you?
Hello, Madame Martin. How are you? / Very well, thank you. And you?
This is my friend Hugo. / Nice to meet you, Hugo.
Thank you very much, sir. / You're welcome.
The museum closes at 6 p.m. / Sorry, can you repeat that, please?
Hi! What's your name? / My name is Chloé. And you?
Hello, what's your name? / My name is Ryan Miller.
Where are you from, Megan? / I'm from New York, but I live in Lyon.
Do you speak English? / Yes, a little. And you, do you speak Spanish?
I love Paris. / Me too!
Do you have brothers and sisters? / Yes, I have one brother and two sisters.
Where do your parents live? / My parents live in Lille.
Who's in the photo? / That's my wife, Camille.
Do you have kids? / Yes, I have two kids, a son and a daughter.
Excuse me, what time is it? / It's a quarter past three.
Hello, how much is the croissant? / One euro twenty.
That's twelve euros, ma'am. / Can I pay by card?
What time does the movie start? / At 8 p.m.
What day is it today? / It's Thursday.
What's the weather like in Nice? / It's nice and warm.
When's your birthday? / My birthday is March 3.
What do you do on weekends? / On weekends, I go to the market and see my friends.
Good evening, do you have a table for two? / Yes, of course. Follow me.
Have you decided? / Yes, I'll have the quiche, please.
For here or to go? / To go, please.
The check, please. / Yes, right away.
What are you having? / A coffee with milk and a croissant, please.
Hello, can I help you? / I'm just looking, thanks.
This jacket is pretty. Can I try it on? / Yes, of course. The fitting rooms are at the back.
How much is this dress? / It's eighty euros.
It looks great on you! / Thanks, I'll take it.
Do you have a bigger size? / Yes, here's the forty.
Is there milk for the coffee? / No, there's no milk.
What time do you get up? / I get up at seven, and you?
Do you live in a house? / No, I live in an apartment in Lyon.
Where's the bathroom? / At the end of the hall, on the right.
Excuse me, ma'am. Where is the train station? / It's very close, at the end of the street.
Excuse me, sir, which way is the Louvre? / It's straight ahead, ten minutes away.
Hello, is there a pharmacy near here? / Yes, there's a pharmacy on the square.
Is the Eiffel Tower far? / No, it's a twenty-minute walk.
Excuse me, I'm lost. I'm looking for Victor Hugo Street. / Take the second street on the left.
Are you going away this weekend? / Yes, I'm going to Lyon by train on Saturday.
What time does the train to Lille leave? / At 2:10 p.m., track B.
When are you getting in? / I don't know, my flight is delayed.
Hello. Your passport, please. / Here you go. I'm here on vacation.
Good evening, I have a reservation under the name Ryan Smith. / Yes, sir. You have room twelve.
Are you OK, Chloé? / Not really, I have a headache.
Excuse me, ma'am, can you help me? / Of course. What's going on?
What's wrong? / I've had a fever since yesterday.
Hello, can I get an appointment with Dr. Martin? / Yes, tomorrow at ten, does that work for you?
Hello, do you have something for a cough? / Yes, this syrup is very good.
Where do you work, Mrs. Martin? / I work in a bank, in Nantes.
What do you do for work? / I'm a nurse at the hospital.
Can you talk now? / No, sorry, I'm in a meeting. I'll call you back.
What are you doing this summer? / I'm looking for an internship in Paris.
Are you going out tonight? / No, I have an exam on Monday. I have to study.
Do you want to go out tonight? / No thanks, I'm tired.
I'm hungry. Shall we eat something? / Yes, there's a crêpe place next door.
Are you cold? / Yes, I'm cold. I'll get my jacket.
So, how's the new job? / I'm happy, my coworkers are nice.
You look tired, Hugo. / Yeah, I didn't sleep much.
What do you do on weekends? / I like movies, so I often go see a film.
Do you play any sports? / Yes, I play soccer on Wednesdays.
Do you want to go to the concert tonight? / I'd love to! What time does it start?
What did you do last night? / Last night I watched a show at home.
What do you like to do on Sundays? / I like reading and going hiking.
I'm not coming tonight. / Why? Are you sick?
We're going to the restaurant. Are you coming? / Yes, I'm on my way!
The train leaves at 5 p.m. / Sorry, what? Can you repeat that?
What's your address? / Twelve, rue de la Paix.
Shall we have a picnic on Sunday? / Why not? If the weather's nice!
How old are you? / I'm twenty-five, and you?
Where are you going? / To the bookstore. I'm looking for a book for my sister.
What are you doing? / I'm listening to the radio in the kitchen.
What are you looking for? / I'm looking for my keys. Have you seen them?
Oh, it's on the left, not the right. / See? I'm right!
The movie starts in ten minutes. / OK. Shall we go?
Where's Lucas? / I don't know, maybe he's late.
Oh sorry, I'm late! / No big deal, we have time.
Shall we meet at eight in front of the movie theater? / Sounds good, see you later.
What are you doing tonight? / Nothing special. Do you want to come over?
Do you want to try my apple tart? / Mmm, it's delicious!
I got my driver's license! / Well done!
Shall we go to the movies tonight? / Good idea!
I'll help you carry the bags. / Thanks, you're really kind.
So, how's this dress? / It looks great on you.
You speak French really well! / Thanks, but I still have a lot to learn.
Your place is really lovely. / Thanks, that's nice of you.
Your new haircut is great. / You think so? Thanks!
I found a new job! / Congratulations!
Thank you for this dinner, it was perfect! / Oh, it's nothing.
You look well! / Thanks, you too!
You're the best cook in the world! / You're exaggerating!
It smells so good! / Thanks, that makes me happy.
I ran ten kilometers this morning. / Hats off!
I'm ready, shall we go? / Yes. You're beautiful, you know.
I think you look very beautiful tonight. / Thanks, you look very handsome too.
You look very handsome tonight. / Thanks! I made an effort.
You have beautiful eyes, you know. / Like in the movie?
You have a lovely smile. / Thanks, that's sweet.
I brought you some croissants. / Oh, you're cute!
Why are you looking at me? / I love your laugh.
You make me laugh, you know. / Good, I love seeing you laugh.
It's already midnight! / Already? I really like talking with you.
I have to tell you something: I like you. / Really? I like you too.
I miss you. / I miss you too. When are you coming back?
Can I buy you a drink? / No thanks, I'm fine.
Mind if I sit down? / Yes, of course.
Can we say tu to each other? / Yes, gladly!
Do you want to get a coffee with me? / With pleasure!
How about having dinner with me on Saturday? / Yes, I'd like that.
Are you free Saturday night? / Yes, why?
Can I have your number? / We'll see. Give me yours first!
I had a great evening with you. Shall we see each other again? / Yes, I'd love to.
You're the most beautiful girl at the party. / Do you say that to all the girls?
You have a gorgeous smile. / Stop, you're making me blush!
Your eyes are more beautiful than the sea. / What a smooth talker!
Do you want to have dinner with me one evening? / That's kind, but I'm not interested.
Are you seeing someone? / Yes. Thanks, but I'm seeing someone.
I really like you, you know. / You're lovely, but I'd rather we stay friends.
Oh dear! It's already ten o'clock! / Don't panic, we have time.
Ouch! I hit my head. / Are you OK? Does it hurt?
The train leaves in a minute! / Phew! We're on time.
We're leaving at six in the morning. / Huh? That early?
What do you want for dessert? / Um… a crêpe, please.
Did you like the movie? / Meh! It wasn't great.
Do you want to try the snails? / Yuck! No thanks!
Darn! I forgot my keys. / No big deal, I have mine.
Come on, let's go, we're going to be late! / Coming, coming!
Here! This is for you. / Oh, thanks! That's sweet!
Hi there! Are you doing well? / Hi! Yes, and you?
Hey! You forgot your bag! / Oh, thanks!
The museum is closed on Tuesdays. / Really? I didn't know.
I have two tickets for the concert. / Great! Thanks!
We're going to the seaside this weekend! / Awesome!
I can't come on Saturday. / Too bad! Another time, then.
Watch out! The bike! / Thanks, I didn't see it.
There are no more croissants. / Oh well! I'll have a pain au chocolat.
The doctor says it's nothing serious. / Good!
I have an exam tomorrow. / Good luck!
I'm playing the lottery tonight. / Good luck!
I went to school with your sister! / Well, I never! It's a small world!
Oh my! You're soaking wet! / Yes, it's raining really hard.
There's the Eiffel Tower! / Wow! It's big!
The restaurant is closed tonight. / What do you mean? We booked!
Achoo! / Bless you!
Hi, I'm Megan. / Welcome, Megan! Come in!
Can I take your car? / No way!
Can I sit here? / Of course!
Good grief! The bus is late again! / As usual!
